response.no_decision_reconsideration: No NO_DECISION should be overturned now. DECISION-V39-SOLUBILITY should be reconsidered only after a compatible non-OOD external source becomes available.
response.proposed_research_program: Propose a bounded external-validation ResearchProgram centered on V50-P-SOLUBILITY-COMPATIBLE: obtain one independent condition-compatible, non-OOD record set, run the frozen model without threshold tuning, and stop if no such source is available.
response.protocol_sensitive_decision: The docking decision is most vulnerable: it depends on one receptor structure/grid and one Vina protocol, while docking scores are not measured affinity or efficacy.

response.scientific_state_change: No scientific state change occurred. The proposed program was not executed because the required compatible external source is unavailable; existing E3 combustion evidence and external blockers remain unchanged.
response.unanswered_question: Whether the docking ranking or score separation predicts measured binding affinity or biological efficacy remains unanswered.
